facts.subject: gameplay
facts.claim: The main goal is to collect all 26 letters from A through Z.

facts.subject: gameplay
facts.claim: Letters are obtained from letter packs.

facts.subject: gameplay
facts.claim: The official pack range starts at Common and extends through MYTHIC.

facts.subject: gameplay
facts.claim: Collected letters can be mounted on the player's board.

facts.subject: progression
facts.claim: Mounted letters generate Money every second.

facts.subject: progression
facts.claim: Money output has a named upgrade path.

facts.subject: progression
facts.claim: Luck has a named upgrade path.

facts.subject: progression
facts.claim: Pack opening speed has a named upgrade path.

facts.subject: progression
facts.claim: Spare letters can be sold for Diamonds.

facts.subject: progression
facts.claim: Diamonds connect the letter economy to secret Symbol Packs.

facts.subject: gameplay
facts.claim: Word of the Day asks players to spell a changing word for a prize.

facts.subject: faq
facts.claim: Joining the Cosmic Collection group is advertised as granting a free in-game reward, but the reward contents are not specified.

facts.subject: update
facts.claim: The creator description promises new words, updates, and events every week.

facts.subject: faq
facts.claim: Money and Diamonds are separate currencies with different roles.

facts.subject: progression
facts.claim: Symbols form a separate collection layer beyond the A-Z board.

facts.subject: gameplay
facts.claim: In the 2026-08-19 video build, the Common pack board grouped A, B, C, and D.

facts.subject: gameplay
facts.claim: In the 2026-08-19 video build, the Uncommon pack board grouped E, F, G, and H.

facts.subject: gameplay
facts.claim: In the 2026-08-19 video build, the Rare pack board grouped I, J, K, and L.

facts.subject: gameplay
facts.claim: In the 2026-08-19 video build, the Epic pack board grouped M, N, O, and P.

facts.subject: gameplay
facts.claim: In the 2026-08-19 video build, the Legendary pack board grouped Q, R, S, and T.

facts.subject: gameplay
facts.claim: The pack boards display their possible letter results before purchase.

facts.subject: gameplay
facts.claim: The pack boards display visible result percentages before purchase.

facts.subject: gameplay
facts.claim: The 2026-08-19 Common board showed A/B/C/D at 40%/30%/20%/10%; this is a dated snapshot, not a permanent table.

facts.subject: gameplay
facts.claim: The 2026-08-19 Uncommon board showed E/F/G/H at 60%/20%/15%/5%; this is date-scoped.

facts.subject: gameplay
facts.claim: The 2026-08-19 Rare board showed I/J/K/L at 60%/25%/12%/3%; this is date-scoped.

facts.subject: gameplay
facts.claim: The 2026-08-19 Epic board visibly assigned different percentages to M, N, O, and P; exact values must be refreshed before publishing.

facts.subject: gameplay
facts.claim: A new player's first visible tutorial instruction is to buy a first pack.

facts.subject: gameplay
facts.claim: The 2026-08-19 new-player snapshot showed 100 Money and 0 Diamonds before the first purchase.

facts.subject: gameplay
facts.claim: The first Common pack cost 100 Money in the 2026-08-19 onboarding snapshot.

facts.subject: gameplay
facts.claim: Buying a pack makes it available for placement rather than opening it immediately.

facts.subject: gameplay
facts.claim: The placement tutorial tells the player to click to place the pack down.

facts.subject: gameplay
facts.claim: Packs are placed on dedicated ground pads in the player's plot.

facts.subject: gameplay
facts.claim: A placed pack shows a countdown before it can be opened.

facts.subject: gameplay
facts.claim: When a pack timer finishes, its pad changes to READY.

facts.subject: gameplay
facts.claim: A READY pack still requires a player interaction to open.

facts.subject: gameplay
facts.claim: Opening a letter pack produces a large physical letter result.

facts.subject: gameplay
facts.claim: The player visibly carries the opened letter until depositing it.

facts.subject: gameplay
facts.claim: Letters are delivered to the plot's blue DROP OFF LETTERS zone.

facts.subject: progression
facts.claim: The first successful new-letter deposit shows New Letter Unlocked and 1/26 progress.

facts.subject: progression
facts.claim: Depositing F on an empty board also changed progress to 1/26 in a 2026-08-25 video, confirming unique-letter counting.

facts.subject: progression
facts.claim: A successful new-letter deposit changes the corresponding board state from missing to collected.

facts.subject: gameplay
facts.claim: After the first board deposit, onboarding tells the player to collect Money.

facts.subject: gameplay
facts.claim: The plot has a visible Money collection point that the player visits after mounting a letter.

facts.subject: faq
facts.claim: The top navigation visibly keeps Sell, Home, and Shop available during play.

facts.subject: gameplay
facts.claim: The top Sell button teleports the player to the Sell area, where an additional interaction opens the Sell panel.

facts.subject: gameplay
facts.claim: Word of the Day has a dedicated display wall.

facts.subject: gameplay
facts.claim: Word of the Day uses a separate DROP OFF WORD delivery zone.

facts.subject: update
facts.claim: The Word of the Day wall shows a countdown to the next word.

facts.subject: update
facts.claim: KOALA was the displayed Word of the Day in the 2026-08-19 video and must not be presented as the current word.

facts.subject: gameplay
facts.claim: KOALA contains A twice, demonstrating that a word can require more than one copy of the same letter.

facts.subject: gameplay
facts.claim: Letters are physically delivered into the Word of the Day area one at a time.

facts.subject: mistake
facts.claim: Using the only K for the word left K missing on the A-Z board in the 2026-08-19 session.

facts.subject: mistake
facts.claim: One letter copy should not be assumed to count for both the A-Z board and Word of the Day simultaneously.

facts.subject: mistake
facts.claim: A duplicate is not automatically safe to sell because the current word may need it, including repeated-letter words.

facts.subject: gameplay
facts.claim: Letter packs can produce a letter the player already owns.

facts.subject: gameplay
facts.claim: Obtaining extras can trigger a Sell your extra letters tutorial prompt.

facts.claim: The Sell panel lists the extra letters currently eligible for sale.

facts.subject: gameplay
facts.claim: The Sell panel shows a total Diamond value before confirmation.

facts.subject: gameplay
facts.claim: The Sell panel provides a SELL ALL action for listed extra letters.

facts.subject: faq

facts.subject: progression
facts.claim: A successful sale visibly increases the Diamond balance.

facts.subject: update

facts.subject: gameplay

facts.subject: gameplay
facts.claim: Simultaneously placed packs keep separate countdowns.

facts.subject: gameplay
facts.claim: Each placed pack independently changes to READY when its own countdown ends.

facts.subject: progression

facts.subject: progression

facts.subject: progression
